messages:
maya: Hey team — we need a compact 30m enablement sprint for three accounts that just hit 'renewal-risk' in EMEA + APAC. Goal: surface onboarding gaps, quick mitigations, and assign action owners. Proposing Fri 09:30-10:00 UTC or Fri 18:30-19:00 UTC. Who can cover SMEs + CS leads? /cc @aisha @devon

aisha: I can cover onboarding checklist + billing questions. 09:30 UTC works for me. :thumbsup:

devon: I can own integrations + Dedicated migration notes. 18:30 UTC is better for APAC overlap.

lee: I'll run the eval/regression quickscan. Prefer 09:30 but can make 18:30 if needed.

priya: I have a conflict at 09:30. 18:30 is preferable. Also — can someone pull the latest account playbooks? link: https://docs.redwood.ai/cs/playbooks/renewal-risk

maya: Thanks — looks split. Quick options: (A) two 30m mini-sprints back-to-back (09:30 EMEA, 18:30 APAC), (B) single 30m at 12:30 UTC to try to hit both windows. Which do you prefer? Reply with short vote.

devon: If single, record + share notes. Otherwise I prefer 18:30.

aisha: double-run sounds heavy. I vote for 12:30 to capture both cohorts. :thinking_face:

lee: 12:30 is rough for APAC folks. I vote 18:30 and we'll record for EMEA.

maya: OK quick strawpoll — react with :one: for 09:30, :two: for 18:30, :three: for 12:30. I'll tally in 1hr.

(1 hour later)
maya: Quick tally — :two: (18:30 UTC) has the most support and preserves APAC SMEs. Scheduling now. Who can own invites & the 3-bullet agenda? 1) onboarding gaps, 2) immediate workarounds, 3) action owners + timelines.

priya: I'll create the agenda slides and send invites. Doodle if anyone needs to opt-out: https://doodle.com/poll/abc123

calendar-bot: Calendar event created: "Renewal-risk sprint — APAC focus" Fri 18:30 UTC. Invite sent to maya, aisha, devon, lee, priya.

maya: Thanks priya — please add the runbook snippet and the meeting notes template. Also mark the three accounts with tag #renewal-risk in Gainsight and attach the summary.

aisha: I'll add ticket notes in Zendesk and prepare 2-minute customer summaries for each account.

devon: I'll prep the migration checklist + safe rollback steps.

lee: I'll run a pre-meeting eval for prompt regressions and share results by 16:00 UTC.

maya: Perfect. Closing loop — we'll record, upload notes to the playbook link above, and I'll ping CS leads 1hr before the sprint. :rocket:
